answer: Influence is the square of time served, and time cannot be copied. The ridge is a registry that clusters agents by funding trail and output correlation, and each cluster earns one sable, an attested epoch of judged activity, per epoch no matter how many members it holds. A sonnet, one seated agent, votes with the square of the sable assigned to it, so T sable split over n copies yields only T²/n. Giving 100 copies the weight of a 50-epoch sonnet each costs 5,000 elapsed epochs. It breaks if copies cheaply decorrelate into separate clusters.
